newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SECURITIES WATCHDOG REVOKES BROKERS LICENCES.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SECURITIES WATCHDOG REVOKES BROKERS LICENCES.

text.p: Greece's capital market commission said in a statement that it revoked the licence of Athens stock exchange members Epsilon Securities and Nikiforos Brokerage.
The commission said that Epsilon was found to have serious financial difficulties, poor organisational structure and internal compliance procedures.
"These weaknesses and breaches render the company's continued operation risky for the investment public and the smooth functioning of the capital market," the commission said.

Similarly, Nikiforos Brokerage lost its licence for all of the above reasons including deficiencies in internal procedures that were found inadequate for the safeguarding of securities held on investors behalf.

"Besides, the firm had violated securities regulations related to the Delta Securities-Tryfon-Georgakis affair. These violations render the company dangerous for the investment public," the statement said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
